title: Fundamental Rights — State (Art. 12) and Laws Inconsistent with Fundamental Rights (Art. 13)

content.overview: Articles 12 and 13 frame the personal scope and legal consequence of Part III. Article 12 defines the State. Article 13 addresses laws inconsistent with fundamental rights.

sections.heading: Article 12 — State
sections.body: Article 12 defines the State for Part III purposes: Government and Parliament of India, Government and Legislature of each State, and all local or other authorities within the territory of India or under the control of the Government of India.

sections.heading: Article 13 — Inconsistent laws
sections.body: Article 13 addresses pre-Constitution and post-Constitution laws inconsistent with Part III, including the prohibition on State making laws that take away or abridge fundamental rights, void to the extent of contravention.
